# GitHub Copilot coding instructions

Read and follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md), [Definition of Done](../docs/governance/definition-of-done.md), and the project Constitution. Never infer acceptance from unit CI, a PR merge or mocks. For each code change link its acceptance record, negative tests and exact commit; open a PR and require owner-approved branch rules. Treat lack of independent review as NOT ACCEPTED. Do not bypass required checks or merge unreviewed stacked branches.
